dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.position_title, ta.position_referal_fees, CASE WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = ? THEN 'Joined' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = '-1' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN ta.applicant_joined='1' THEN 'Joined' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) THEN 'Rejected' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to > ? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') WHEN (SELECT application_property_value FROM tp_application_properties WHERE application_property=?) = ? THEN CASE WHEN ta.position_step_isscheduled=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END AS currentStatus FROM ( SELECT tasp.position_step_id_to, ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, tp.position_title,tp.position_referal_fees ,tps.position_step_title,tps.position_step_isscheduled,ta.applicant_joined FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON(ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id ) LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id ) LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_selection_process tasp ON (ta.applicant_id=tasp.applicant_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON(tp.position_id=tpl.position_id) WHERE ta.vendor_id = ? AND ta.source_id=? AND ifnull(ta.is_employee_apply,0) = ? @@ ORDER BY tasp.process_id DESC ) AS ta GROUP BY ta.applicant_id ORDER BY @@ LIMIT ?, ?

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.position_title, ta.position_referal_fees, CASE WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = ? THEN 'Joined' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = '-1' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) THEN 'Rejected' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to > ? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') WHEN (SELECT application_property_value FROM tp_application_properties WHERE application_property=?) = ? THEN CASE WHEN ta.position_step_isscheduled=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END AS currentStatus FROM (SELECT tasp.position_step_id_to, tasp.process_id, ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, tp.position_title, tp.position_referal_fees, tps.position_step_title, tp.position_id, tps.position_step_isscheduled FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON(tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON(tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(tasp.position_step_id_to=tps.position_step_id) WHERE ta.vendor_id = ? AND ta.source_id=? AND ta.is_employee_apply=? AND tp.position_id=? AND tasp.process_id=? ORDER BY tasp.process_id DESC) AS ta

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.position_title, ta.position_referal_fees, CASE WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = ? THEN 'Joined' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to = '-1' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) THEN 'Rejected' WHEN ta.position_step_id_to > ? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') WHEN (SELECT application_property_value FROM tp_application_properties WHERE application_property=?) = ? THEN CASE WHEN ta.position_step_isscheduled=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', ta.position_step_title, ')') END AS currentStatus FROM (SELECT tasp.position_step_id_to, tasp.process_id, ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_current_employer, tp.position_title, tp.position_referal_fees, tps.position_step_title, tp.position_id, tps.position_step_isscheduled FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON(tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON(tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(tasp.position_step_id_to=tps.position_step_id) WHERE ta.vendor_id = ? AND ta.source_id=? AND ta.is_employee_apply=? ORDER BY tasp.process_id DESC Limit 1) AS ta where ta.process_id=(select max(tpsad.process_id) from tp_applicant_selection_process tpsad where tpsad.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id and tpsad.position_id=ta.position_id)
SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON(ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id ) WHERE ta.vendor_id=? AND ta.source_id=? @@

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_original_resume_path, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.applicant_working_since, case when (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history tajh where tajh.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) > 0 then ? else ? end as applicant_joined, ta.current_ctc, ta.expected_ctc, ta.current_ctc_date, ta.expected_ctc_date, ta.applicant_position_id, ta.applicant_step_id, (select group_concat(iss.skill ORDER BY iss.skill SEPARATOR ', ') from tp_skills iss, tp_applicant_skills ias where ias.skill_id=iss.skill_id and ias.applicant_id = ta.applicant_id group by ias.applicant_id) as skills FROM tp_applicants ta WHERE ta.user_id = ? AND ta.source_id=? AND ta.applicant_id= ?

SELECT interaction_id, interaction_type, interaction_date, interaction_subject FROM( ( SELECT process_id as interaction_id, ? as interaction_type, process_moved_date as interaction_date, CONCAT(position_title, ' (', activity, ')') as interaction_subject FROM ( SELECT tasp.process_id, tp.position_title,tasp.process_moved_date, CASE WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to = ? THEN 'Joined' WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to = '-1' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) THEN 'Rejected' WHEN tps.position_step_level=? THEN tps.position_step_title WHEN (SELECT application_property_value FROM tp_application_properties WHERE application_property=?) = ? THEN CASE WHEN tps.position_step_isscheduled=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', tps.position_step_title, ')') ELSE 'In Process' END ELSE 'In Process' END AS activity FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(tasp.position_step_id_to=tps.position_step_id) ,tp_applicants ta ,tp_positions tp , tp_position_vendors tpv WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id AND tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tp.position_id= tpv.position_id AND ta.source_id=tpv.source_id AND ta.user_id=? AND ta.source_id=? AND tasp.applicant_id=? ) as talias_process ) UNION ( SELECT communication_id AS interaction_id, communication_type_id AS interaction_type, communication_date_created AS interaction_date, communication_text AS interaction_subject FROM tp_communications WHERE applicant_id =? AND communication_type_id=? AND user_id=? ) ) AS interactions ORDER BY interaction_date desc
select ta.applicant_id from tp_applicants ta where ta.source_id=? and ta.vendor_id=? and ta.is_employee_apply=? and ta.applicant_name= (select ts.source_title from tp_sources ts where ts.source_id=?)
select max(process_id) as process_id from tp_applicant_selection_process tps where tps.applicant_id=? and tps.position_id=?
select tp.position_id from tp_positions tp where tp.position_title=?
select tpl.location_id from tp_location_ap tpl where tpl.location_name=?
select position_title from tp_positions where position_title like ? and is_published_for_emp_portal=?

select position_title from tp_positions tp where position_title like ? and tp.position_status = ? and tp.position_id in (select tpv.position_id from tp_position_vendors tpv where tpv.source_id=(select tu.user_source_id from tp_users tu where tu.user_id=?)) and tp.vendor_publish_from_date <= ? and tp.vendor_publish_to_date >= ?
select location_name from tp_location_ap where location_name like ?
